column1: # Polish (pl) interface catalog. Columns, separated by a TAB:
#   context <TAB> English source <TAB> translation
#   context    empty (WordCraft uses no contexts yet)
#   source     the English text exactly as in the code (tl!(...), ribbon labels, command labels)
#   escapes    \n  \t  \\  inside a column. `{name}` placeholders must appear in both columns, and a
#              trailing "…" in one needs one in the other.
#   Lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored. A missing entry shows in English.
# Clean room: translated from the meaning of the English labels in this repository into ordinary
# Polish computing vocabulary. No Microsoft Word (or other product) localisation, string table or
# translated UI was consulted or copied; add entries the same way.
# Product, format and technology names (WordCraft, PDF, Markdown, MCP …) stay as they are.
# Conventions: commands are imperatives (Zapisz, Wstaw), tabs and groups are nouns; counts use
# a label and a colon ("Słowa: 21") so every number reads grammatically; quotes are „…”.
# Author: Konrad Witkowski with Claude (AI agent); licensed MIT OR Apache-2.0, like WordCraft.
# Not yet reviewed by a second native speaker.
